8|
9|That night, he led them to the highest pine, the same one where Corvus had once taught him. He pointed to the North Star and showed them how the sky turned around it. 10|
11|Weeks passed. Azul taught them to feel the earth's pull in their bones and to taste the coming rain on the wind. He never told them where to fly. He only showed them how to read the signs and trust what they found.
12|
